svg.title: Slussen architecture overview
svg.desc: Source teams deliver batches to S3 under data contracts; an event-driven contract gate on AWS validates them; Snowpipe loads a Snowflake medallion platform that serves Power BI and Cortex Analyst.
svg.text: Contract-enforced, event-driven ingestion from S3 into a Snowflake medallion platform, serving Power BI and natural-language analytics that return the same numbers
One folder per batch, marker file last
Starts one run per landed batch
From a file in the repo
Typed, append-only copies with file metadata
Row access by market, PII masking
Contract violations, load log, DQ results,
Runs as the user's own role
• Airflow 3 in Docker Compose runs producers and checks
• Missed slots caught up oldest first, failed runs backfilled
• Lake to warehouse reconciliation every 4 hours
• Freshness per contract SLA, 9 checks over 3 layers
• A blocking finding fails the run
• IAM Identity Center for people, narrow roles for workloads
• Encrypted lake, secrets kept in Secrets Manager
• Roles and grants as code, key-pair service users
• Row access by market, tag-based PII masking
• Business comments and tags on every Gold object
• Terraform: 105 live objects imported, plan clean
• GitHub Actions CI, hash-pinned lock files
• Bash deploy scripts linted with ShellCheck
• Images and actions pinned by digest or SHA
• Generated DDL guarded by sync tests
Silver and Gold are Snowflake dynamic tables; Gold refreshes within 12 hours
